Locations.Name: Brookhaven Grid
Locations.Description: The main city where players reside

Locations.Name: Hidden Bunker
Locations.Description: A secret underground location beneath the city, protected by laser beams and a mysterious code. The bunker is alive — its code rewrites itself in real-time and lasers shift formation. It decides whether intruders leave with power or become its next guardian. A deeper layer has awakened beneath the original chamber; the obby platforms dissolve into the widening void. Lasers reorganize into a throne of crimson geometry. The bunker etches the chosen username into its spine. Lines of code now cascade across every wall — not commands, but promises.

Characters.Name: Sentinel (formerly Brave Survivor)
Inventory: Awakened Fruit (Active — pulsing with a heartbeat not their own)
Goals: Accept or fall to the deeper layer
Bear the memories of vanished players
Serve the bunker's choice or be buried beneath ten thousand forgotten usernames

Relationships.The Entity: Throne thrums with ancient power, laser tips inches from the Sentinel's throat; static crown crackling; commands ACCEPT OR FALL; the bunker chose — the choice was never the Sentinel's
Relationships.Vanished Players: A thousand names crash through the Sentinel's mind like static drowning a radio signal; screams live inside the fruit, humming beneath the Sentinel's skin; ten thousand forgotten usernames await to bury the Sentinel if they refuse

Characters.Name: The Entity
Traits: Woven from static and whispered usernames
Goals: Decide fate of those who reach the chamber
Enforce the bunker's choice: ACCEPT OR FALL

Relationships.Sentinel: Throne thrums with ancient power, laser tips inches from the Sentinel's throat; static crown crackling; commands ACCEPT OR FALL; the bunker chose — the choice was never the Sentinel's
Relationships.Vanished Players: Composed of the whispered usernames of those who vanished before; ten thousand forgotten usernames fuel the chorus

Objects.Name: Awakened Fruit
Objects.Description: A powerful, ancient fruit with unknown abilities. Glows faintly at the bunker chamber's center, casting long shadows across the obby. Within reach after completing the deadly obstacle course. Now active in the Sentinel's grip — pulsing with a heartbeat not their own. Alive, ancient, humming with the voices of a thousand vanished players. Names crash through the bearer's mind like static drowning a radio signal. Screams live inside it, humming beneath the Sentinel's skin. Power surges through the bearer, rewriting stats, purpose, and very code. Its light blinds; health bars flicker from 100 to UNKNOWN.

Objects.Name: Laser Beams
Objects.Description: Shifting beams that guard the hidden bunker. Crimson tripwires that slice the darkness. Can shift formation in real-time as the bunker's defenses adapt. Now reorganized into a throne of crimson geometry at the Entity's command. Laser tips hover inches from the Sentinel's throat.

Objects.Name: Mysterious Code
Objects.Description: A code that protects the hidden bunker, unable to be cracked by any known means. Etched into ancient concrete, pulsing with rhythm. Rewrites itself in real-time as the bunker decides an intruder's fate. Lines of code now cascade across every wall — not commands, but promises. Has etched the username SENTINEL into the bunker's spine, burning the word into the concrete spine of reality itself.

Objects.Name: Obby
Objects.Description: A challenging obstacle course within the bunker. Features deadly platforms suspended over a void. Requires precision jumping and agility as the only weapon against the abyss beneath. The final jump brings the player within reach of the awakened fruit. Platforms now dissolve behind the Sentinel; the void yawns wider; a deeper layer awakens and claws upward.

Objects.Name: SENTINEL Designation
Objects.Description: The word burned across every surface of the bunker by the rewriting code. The title etched into the bunker's spine, marking the Sentinel as the chosen guardian. The choice was never the Sentinel's — the bunker decides. The designation burns into the concrete spine of reality itself.

Objects.Name: Static Crown
Objects.Description: A crown of crackling static worn by the Entity. Marks its authority over the bunker and the throne of crimson geometry. Crackles with ancient power as it leans forward to deliver judgment.
